title: Payment Operations Reference: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Cutoff, Allocation Order, Day Basis and Channel Fees
content:
**Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract — payment processing figures.** These figures are identical on all six tiers (Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 5, Tier 4, Tier 3, Tier 2, Tier 1 and Tier 1+).

| Figure | Value on every tier |
|---|---|
| Payment cutoff (Central Time, business days) | 20:00 |
| Allocation order of a payment | accrued interest, then principal, then fees due |
| Days in the year for daily simple interest | 365 |
| Debit card payments accepted per calendar month | 2 |
| Largest single debit card payment | 2,500.00 USD (2500 dollars) |

## Convenience fee by payment channel (USD, collected on top of the payment)

| Channel | Fee |
|---|---|
| Online ACH | 0.00 |
| Autopay ACH | 0.00 |
| Automated phone line (IVR) ACH | 0.00 |
| Agent-assisted phone ACH | 0.00 |
| Agent-assisted phone debit card | 5.95 |
| Mailed check | 0.00 |
| Cashier's check | 0.00 |
| Wire | 0.00 |
| MoneyGram | 0.00 |

## Reading the figures

- A payment received before 20:00 Central Time on a business day posts that day; one received later than that, or on a weekend or US federal holiday, posts the next business day.
- Daily simple interest uses a 365-day year: the interest for one day is the principal balance times the contract APR, divided by 365.
- The agent-assisted phone debit card is the only channel carrying a convenience fee; a third debit card payment in the same calendar month is beyond the monthly limit of 2, and a single card payment above 2,500.00 dollars is beyond the per-payment limit.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a customer paying 300.00 dollars by agent-assisted phone debit card is charged 5.95 dollars on top, so 305.95 dollars leaves the card while 300.00 dollars is the payment applied to the contract.
